Based on community feedback from r/AiForSmallBusiness.

Initial release of QSR Labor Leak Auditor — a daily, mid-week, and weekly labor cost monitoring tool for restaurant operators.

- Tracks daily labor hours and costs as a % of sales, flags overages, and builds a running weekly picture.
- Issues mid-week alerts with projections, offering specific hours-to-cut suggestions based on current trends.
- Generates detailed weekly labor summaries with day-by-day breakdowns and actionable recommendations.
- Automatically detects patterns of clock padding, scheduling drift, volume-labor mismatch, and overtime risk.
- Includes a diagnostic workflow for investigating and quantifying clock padding when suspected.
- Setup allows customization for labor target, tracking method, average hourly cost, payroll close, and staffing levels.
